primary_cta: Book a heart-checkup appointment and confirm that WhatsApp details will be shared
fallback_cta: If the visit day is not finalized, note the enquiry and let the hospital team follow up
success_criteria: The caller shows interest in heart checkup
Full name and age are captured
BP or sugar status and family heart history are captured
A visit day is agreed and the caller is told that WhatsApp details will be sent
